title: NN-Based Transistor Modeling for Ultra-Fast SPICE Simulation and Standard Cell Library Characterization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31024v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural network (NN)-based transistor models have proven to be a promising solution to accelerate device modeling. Although these models demonstrated remarkable speedup in circuit simulations, they were not rigorously tested in complex tasks within standard EDA tool flows for chip design, which require very high transistor model precision to provide accurate results and converge properly. To investigate their full potential and promise, we develop NN-based transistor models that accurately predict the drain current and various charges for a 3nm nanosheet, and employ the models for a standard cell library characterization. This enables us to evaluate the accuracy and speedup under a very wide range of SPICE simulations, benchmarking our models against an industry-standard implementation. translated_title: 基于神经网络的晶体管建模：用于超快速SPICE仿真与标准单元库表征
translated_abstract: 基于神经网络（NN）的晶体管模型已被证明是加速器件建模的一种有前景的解决方案。尽管这些模型在电路仿真中展现出了显著的加速效果，但它们尚未在芯片设计标准EDA工具流程的复杂任务中得到严格测试，而这些任务要求晶体管模型具有极高的精度，才能提供准确的结果并正确收敛。为了充分探究其潜力和前景，我们开发了基于神经网络的晶体管模型，能够准确预测3nm纳米片器件的漏极电流和各类电荷，并将这些模型应用于标准单元库表征。这使我们能够在非常广泛的SPICE仿真范围内评估模型的精度和加速效果，并与工业标准实现进行基准对比。由于标准单元库表征涉及数千次SPICE仿真，它可以作为检验晶体管模型质量和收敛性的绝佳测试基准。
tldr: 本文开发了能精确预测3nm纳米片晶体管漏极电流和电荷的神经网络模型，并首次在涉及数千次SPICE仿真的标准单元库表征这一复杂EDA流程中，严格验证了其相比工业标准模型的精度与超快速仿真能力。
en_tdlr: This paper develops NN-based transistor models that accurately predict drain current and charges for a 3nm nanosheet, and rigorously validates their accuracy and ultra-fast SPICE simulation performance in standard cell library characterization—a complex EDA workflow involving thousands of simulations—against industry-standard implementations.
